name: Pedalboard
inspiration: The site as a pedalboard: every section is a stompbox in a classic finish — surf green, candy red, cream, burst gold — wired in a signal chain on black tolex. Stomp a pedal to open its section.

display.note: Enclosure-print uppercase, like silkscreen on a stompbox

utility.stack: 'JetBrains Mono Variable', ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, Menlo, monospace
utility.note: Jack labels: IN, OUT, 9V DC, section indices

motion.note: Click stomps the pedal: it presses down (scale + shadow), its LED snaps on, then a patch cable draws itself (stroke-dashoffset) from the pedal's OUT jack toward the content panel, which slides in like a rack unit. Only one LED is lit at a time — the lit pedal is the open section.
